profile.name: Sheikh Haseeb
profile.title: AI/ML Engineer
profile.tagline: Turning curiosity into intelligent systems — one model, one agent, one solution at a time.
profile.bio: AI/ML Engineer based in Srinagar with 1 year of experience building ML pipelines, RAG systems, and agentic AI solutions. Currently at Cogveel Technologies. Open-source contributor (OMR checker). Passionate about turning curiosity into knowledge — through code, models, and teaching.

differentiators: Agentic AI builds — hands-on with LangChain and agent workflows
End-to-end ML pipelines — from data to model to API to deployment
Open-source contributor — OMR checker with API, database, and UI
projects_description: RAG systems, computer vision, and ML-powered products — including proprietary builds and open-source contributions.

projects.title: RAG Chatbot for Docs
projects.problem: Users upload a PDF and get accurate answers grounded in that document.
projects.description: Designed and built document ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipelines for a client-facing RAG Q&A product.

projects.title: End-to-End OMR Processing System
projects.problem: Examiners photograph or scan filled answer sheets and need fast, reliable digitization.
projects.description: Built an end-to-end OMR processing system that aligns sheets using side timing marks, reads 120+ bubble fields, flags low-quality uploads, scores against an answer key, and provides batch history with export and search via a Flask REST API and SQLite persistence.

projects.title: Finna.ai — Browser Extension
projects.problem: E-commerce and marketing teams struggle to understand how users interact with product pages — Finna.ai scores engagement and buying intent in real time to help prioritize leads and content.
projects.description: Built ML models and scoring logic for engagement and buying-intent signals, integrated into the Finna.ai browser extension.

projects.title: ConsultancyAI — Study-Abroad Chatbot
projects.problem: Students looking to study abroad struggle to explore universities, evaluate matching programs, and connect with counsellors.
projects.description: AI-powered study-abroad conversational chatbot built using Python, FastAPI, and OpenRouter LLMs. Understands student queries, extracts preferences (preferred country, budget, academic background, IELTS score), and retrieves real university/program information from backend services to submit enquiries directly to counsellors.

experience.title: AI/ML Engineer
bullets: Design and build RAG-based document Q&A pipelines using Python, LangChain, and FAISS for client-facing products.
Develop ML features end-to-end — data ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and API integration with FastAPI/Flask.
Contribute to Finna.ai, a browser extension that scores user engagement and buying intent on web pages.
Collaborate on agentic AI workflows and deploy models/services with Docker for production use.
